title: EIA 2023: U.S. utility-scale Natural gas generation 1,802 billion kWh, 43.1%
summary: The EIA's preliminary 2023 table lists Natural gas at 1,802 billion kWh, 43.1% of utility-scale generation.
body: In the EIA table of U.S. utility-scale electricity generation by source for 2023, the row Natural gas is 1,802 billion kWh, 43.1% of the total. The table source line says U.S. Energy Information Administration, Electric Power Monthly, February 2024, preliminary data. The total on that table is 4,178 billion kWh. This is net generation from plants of at least one megawatt, as the FAQ defines utility-scale. It is not small-scale rooftop solar, and it is not a projection.
